name: Sales Commission Leaderboard
prompt: "Build a 'Sales Commission Leaderboard'. The dataset includes: Rep Name, Region, Total Sales ($), Commission Earned ($), and Performance Notes (Text).At the top of the app, include a dropdown selector called 'Simulated User Role' with options: 'Regional Manager' and 'Sales Representative'.If 'Regional Manager' is selected, display the full table with all data visible.If 'Sales Representative' is selected, prompt the user to type their name. The app must then blur or hide the 'Commission Earned' and 'Performance Notes' columns for all other reps, while keeping the 'Total Sales' visible for leaderboard competition."

thought_process.interpretation: I am acting as an Expert React Developer building a specialized Sales Commission Leaderboard for a Data Cloud application. The goal is to implement a role-based access control (RBAC) simulation where 'Regional Managers' have full visibility, while 'Sales Representatives' can only see their own sensitive data (Commission and Notes) while still participating in the competitive leaderboard for Total Sales.
assumed_from_scratch: A 200-row dataset of sales representatives across four global regions.
A performance note generation engine to simulate qualitative data.
Blur/Hide logic for sensitive data columns based on user identity.
A Top 10 performance chart to enhance the 'Leaderboard' feel.
thought_process.skill_suggestions: Future enhancements could include an 'Admin' role for editing commission percentages, a 'Regional' filter for the chart, and integration with a real-time notification system when a rep hits their quota.
